title: The RISC-V Privileged Architecture
description: Read the RISC-V privileged specification as a compiler author: CSR encodings and their accessibility fields, the satp page-table format, and the relocation records a walk emits.
author: Underlayer
completion_criteria: Read all 4 concepts, reproduce the 398 checks in courses/rvpriv/assets/samples/crosscheck.py against the shipped rvpriv.out, then break one of the four numbers a poison claims and watch the delta move by name. The 398 includes eighteen pinned claim sentences, because a scope list you can soften without editing a test is not a scope list.

modules.title: The Address, the Bits, and the Trap

concepts.title: The CSR Address and the Twelve Instructions That Touch It
concepts.description: MEASURED, because encodings are bytes. Twelve CSR instructions, three operations, two forms, and the whole of the difference between them is ONE BIT of funct3: funct3 is 1, 2, 3 for the register forms CSRRW/CSRRS/CSRRC and 5, 6, 7 for the immediate forms, so 1^5 = 2^6 = 3^7 = 4 and every one of the three XORs is 0x04 at bit 2. Then the CSR ADDRESS, which is where the privilege lives: twelve bits, decomposed into csr[11:10] (read/write versus read-only) and csr[9:8] (the lowest privilege that may touch it) -- and encoding 2 in the privilege field is a HOLE, with the table saying so. The boundaries are measured BY REFUSAL, in the assembler's own words: 0x7ff, 0x800 and 0xfff all accepted, 0x1000 refused with `immediate must be an integer in the range [0, 4095]`, and the five-bit immediate has its own boundary at 31. And the gap the sibling decoder has: `-march=rv64i` emits `csrr` and writes `Tag_RISCV_arch = rv64i2p1`, so the ISA string does not notice that Zicsr was used at all.

concepts.title: Sv39, Sv48, Sv57 and satp, Measured on the Compiler's Own Shifts
concepts.description: Sv39, Sv48 and Sv57 differ by ONE number, and it is arithmetic: 4096 / 8 = 512, 3 x 9 + 12 = 39 levels, 64 - 4 - 16 - 8 = 36 bits of PPN in satp. The trap is that 36 is neither of the two numbers a reader will reach for -- 44 comes from the manual's PTE figure and 54 from the PTE's own field -- and this corpus SHIPS BOTH WRONG MASKS on purpose so the wrongness can be measured rather than asserted. The compiler emits `slli a0, a0, 0x14 ; srli a0, a0, 0x1c` for 44 and `0x2`/`0xa` for 54, and a 54-bit mask swallows the entire ASID with nothing in the emitted code saying so. The A/D bits land as `slli 0x3e` down to `srli 0x38`, and MODE has NO slli at all because the mask optimised away. Then the relocations: 23, 24, 25 are consecutive for a reason, the HI20 names the TARGET and the LO12 names a LOCAL LABEL THE COMPILER INVENTED, and reading inst[31:20] out of an S-type word hands you rs2 rather than an immediate.

concepts.title: ecall, the Five Registers, and Why the Mode Is Not in the Instruction
concepts.description: The syscall convention is quoted (`riscv-elf` chapter 3) and then measured AS EMITTED, which is weaker and is labelled so. What is measured: the constant 0x00000073, a7 as the syscall number, and the stronger form -- `li a7, 0x40` and `li a6, 0x40` differ in EXACTLY ONE BIT of one instruction, and that bit is rd[0], because the ABI names a register by the low five bits of the destination field. What is not measured: that the trap is taken, that it reaches supervisor mode, that a7 is read, that anything returns. The three stvec functions are the finding: Direct, Vectored and a misaligned value all emit the SAME 32 bits, 0x10559073, so the mode is a property of the VALUE and the enforcement is hardware this host does not have. And the enable bits -- cause 1, 5, 9 are 1 << 1, 1 << 5, 1 << 9, read straight out of the compiler's `ori` immediates, which is the quoted rule measured without quoting it.

concepts.title: What This Course Measured, and What It Refused To
concepts.description: The measured/quoted boundary as a 44-row table with the count printed, because a percentage in a sentence is a number nobody can check: 8 MEASURED, 13 MEASURED-ON-BYTES, 23 QUOTED, and the comparison with the AArch64 data-path course is printed BOTH WAYS because this course's quoted fraction is smaller and saying so would be making a number up. Sixteen numbered limits, then EIGHT things a reader therefore CANNOT conclude beside TEN they can -- pinned whole, sentence by sentence, by the harness. Seventeen retractions with a SOURCE line each, including the two that are not about the reader at all: R10 says the course cannot say what a trap DOES, and R14 admits the defect is in a SIBLING's decoder. Four poisons, each required to MOVE the number it claims: remove the two prepended models and 146 words stop being named; plant 10,797 disagreements and the working check catches 10,797 while the broken one hides 639. The last page is the two-reader cross-check and the discipline around it.
